---
title: "Box Office Numbers"
---

This website explores a dataset of films released between 1980 and 2025, including production budgets, worldwide box office revenues, runtimes, and IMDb ratings. Financial figures are approximate, reported in millions of US dollars, and are not adjusted for inflation. The analyses examine relationships between film characteristics, ratings, and box office performance.
